disposition_reason: Some required behaviors are directly implemented (candidate ingestion, preservation, unresolved handling, output schema). Others are NOT implemented (multi-label support, routing to different destinations, six-class visual taxonomy).

Candidate ingestion.evidence: load_records() reads pix2text_candidates.jsonl via REPORT_PATH.replace(). Each record carries: raw_ocr, parser_match_ids, adjudication, match_status, bbox_original, _pix2text_file, candidate_class, element_type, parse_error.

Visual classification.evidence: classify() assigns match_status: UNADJUDICATED, SPATIAL_MATCH, TEXT_MATCH, VISUALLY_VERIFIED, ADJUDICATED. candidate_class field (DISPLAY_EQUATION, INLINE_MATH, PROSE) is carried through unchanged.
Visual classification.note: Maps to match_status taxonomy, not the six-class visual taxonomy (equation_structure, extensible_delimiters, individual_symbols, plot_geometry, plot_annotations, image_regions). Six-class visual classification NOT implemented.

Multi-label support.evidence: Each row receives exactly one match_status value. No secondary_classes or multiple classification retention. classify() returns row after first match; no branching to retain multiple classes.

Routing.evidence: All records written to single output file adjudication_report.jsonl. No routing logic to different destinations based on class.

Preservation.evidence: Original crops, coordinates, _pix2text_file, bbox_original, raw_ocr, parse_error all preserved in output records. Read-only on harvest output.

Unresolved handling.evidence: Records with no spatial match fall through to text and visual checks; unknown candidates remain VISUALLY_VERIFIED or UNADJUDICATED but are never discarded.

Output.evidence: Writes adjudication_report.jsonl (per-record), adjudication_summary.json (aggregate), adjudication_report.md (human-readable). Serialized schema: match_status, candidate_class, _morphology, _derivation.

six_class_visual_taxonomy.note: Match_status taxonomy (5 values) is distinct from six-class visual taxonomy. The script does not distinguish plot vs equation vs symbol; it distinguishes spatial/text/visual adjudication.

conclusion: adjudicate_candidates_v2.py is a VISUAL-INTEGRITY ADJUDICATION LAYER, not a SIX-CLASS VISUAL CLASSIFICATION ROUTER. It preserves evidence and adjudicates candidate status for the Pix2Text pipeline but does NOT implement the six-class visual routing.
